title: The member app can show a personal training pack as the member's gym plan
what: My membership in the member app takes whichever plan running today ends last, and treats any plan starting later as a paid renewal. A personal training pack counts for both. The admin app never lets a PT pack decide the member's gym status while they have a gym plan. So a member whose gym plan ends on the 30th and whose PT pack ends on the 15th of next month sees the PT pack, 'Ends 15 Dec', no 'Renew at the desk' line, while the admin app puts them on the renewals list. A PT pack bought to start later hides the renew line and stops every plan-ends reminder on the phone. Turned the other way, a gym plan ending after the PT pack hides the PT sessions count and the 'PT running low' reminder. The test gym has no PT packs, so this was found by reading the code, not on data.
expected: The member app picks the gym plan the same way the admin app does: a PT pack is shown as an add-on beside the gym plan, never in its place, and never counts as a renewal.
who: members with a personal training pack
how_often: every member who has a PT pack next to a gym plan
fix_line: Leave PT packs out when picking the member's current and next gym plan, and show the PT pack as its own line

title: A timed message to everyone can show 'Seen by' more people than it went to
what: When the owner sets a message to go out later, the 'of y' number is counted on the day it is set, from who is in the app then. The 'Seen by x' number counts everyone who joined before the message went out. Members who join the app between setting and sending get the message in their inbox and are counted as seen, but are not in the 'of y' number, so the owner can read 'Seen by 12 of 10'. On the test gym no one joined in that gap, so the numbers agree today.
expected: Both numbers count the same people: who was in the app when the message went out.
how_often: timed messages to everyone, when someone joins before it goes out
fix_line: Count the recipients of a timed message to everyone when it goes out, or count seen only for people counted in the total

evidence: data-count: Crispy Curves app members 1, messages 3 (1 timed), PT packs 0, future plans 0, future visits 0, duplicate visit days 0
